blocks.html: Mark a casualty on the map and send a complete 9-line / ZMIST report to HQ.

slides.title: Drop the CASEVAC marker
slides.html: Open the additional tools menu, select the CASEVAC icon, then tap the casualty location on the map to place the marker.

slides.title: Fine-tune the location
slides.html: The marker opens a radial menu. Use Fine Adjust to nudge the point onto the exact spot. Long press the yellow arrows for extra fine adjustment.

slides.title: Open the CASEVAC details
slides.html: Select the Details icon on the radial to open the CASEVAC details window where you fill in the report.

slides.title: Fill the nine lines
slides.html: Work down lines 1 to 9: location, callsign, Patient by Precedence, Patient by Type, enemy in area, and Patients by Nationality. Add free text under Remarks.

slides.title: Add a ZMIST report
slides.html: Next to ZMIST, select Add to attach a ZMIST report (ZAP number, Mechanism, Injury, Signs, Treatment). Tap Add again for more casualties; use Delete to remove one.

slides.title: Attach files and send
slides.html: Select the Attachment (paperclip) icon to add photos or files. When the report is complete, select Send to push the CASEVAC to your contacts.
